P.name: Mark of the Storm
P.title: Template:Data Kennen/Mark of the Storm
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Mark of the Storm|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kennen
|skill        = I
|icon         = Mark of the Storm.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Kennen}} {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit.
|blurb2      = The third stack consumes them all to briefly {{tip|stun}} the target and restore {{as|{{sti|energy}}}}. The duration is dramatically reduced if this occurs on the same target again within a few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kennen's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
|description2 = The third stack against a target consumes them all to {{tip|stun}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and restore {{sti|{{as|25 energy}}}}. The stun duration is reduced to {{fd|0.5}} seconds if this occurs on the same target again within 6 seconds. 
|description3 = ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} can apply only up to 3 stacks on a target.''
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = True
|notes        = 
* '''Kennen''' will still restore energy if the target dies from the third stack of ''Mark of the Storm''.
* After {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} applies its third stack, the target gains a 6-second stack immunity against ''Slicing Maelstrom'' that refreshes on subsequent hits.
}}

E.name: Lightning Rush

|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kennen}} becomes lightning, a {{tip|ghosted}} form that gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time. He deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through and restores {{sti|{{as|energy}}}} if he damaged an enemy at all. ''Lightning Rush'' can be recast within the duration and automatically recasts afterwards.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Kennen''' ends ''Lightning Rush'' to gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds. {{Tip|Critical strikes}} extend the duration slightly.

|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}
|description4 = ''Lightning Rush's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
